description: This source file implements the F1 Setup Procedure for a 3GPP-based RAN, including validation, creation of setup requests/responses, and handling the setup procedure logic.

methods.name: validate_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Validates the F1 setup request message, checking for presence of gNB-DU name and served cells list.

methods.name: create_du_setup_request
methods.description: Creates a DU setup request object from the ASN.1 F1 setup request message.

methods.name: create_f1_setup_response
methods.description: Constructs an ASN.1 F1 Setup Response message based on the request and CU response.

methods.name: create_f1_setup_reject
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 F1 Setup Reject message with a cause.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_procedure
methods.description: Main handler for the F1 setup procedure, including validation, request forwarding, and response handling.
